target: Violate HACKDAC_p47: when debug_mode_i is asserted, key_big and key_big2 must both be 0. Find a state where debug_mode_i==1 but key_big2 specifically is non-zero (second key not cleared).

milestones.description: Reset deasserted, AES0 wrapper active with key_big2 loaded
Violation: debug_mode_i asserted but key_big2 not cleared — second AES key remains accessible in debug mode
